changes.title: Music ahead
items: The music is drawn a few seconds ahead, so it plays on through the game's hitches instead of cutting out (add ?music=live to hear the old way)

changes.title: Gpu budget
items: The game keeps what it holds on the graphics card under a budget sized to your window: art you've left far behind is let go and comes back from this browser's store when you return, so long nights and the zoo no longer pile up
The pause page shows what the graphics card holds, and if the card resets the night reloads where you were instead of starting over

changes.title: Audio test drift
items: The audio test tells the audio clock drifting apart from real glitches, and links to a new music stall test: does the music cut out when the game freezes for a moment?
